ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 driver-cancellation (no-show) fee; no refund to the rider.
ruling.reasoning:
The cancellation was made by the driver, so NS-0 routes the case to the no-show branch (NS-1/NS-2) because the driver's recorded reason is rider no-show [F4][F11][F13][NS-0]. The fee can only stand if NS-1 (i)–(iii) all hold [NS-1].

(i) Arrival was confirmed by the driver's own tap, recorded as driver_tap at 18:24:35 — the record is not a platform auto-confirmation and I do not describe it as one [F6][NS-1].

(ii) At that tap the GPS placed the car 41 m from the pickup point (closest approach overall 38 m), i.e. inside the 200 m arrival radius [F6][F1][NS-1].

(iii) After the tap the car remained within 200 m continuously for 3 min 50 s (230 s) until the 18:28:25 cancellation — more than the 3-minute default, and the trace confirms the wait window has no GPS hole between the arrival confirmation and the cancellation [F6][F3][F4][F2][NS-1].

The rider's message "Coming down, give me 2 more minutes" [F10] was sent at 18:25, after the arrival confirmation, and the ride was still not boarded when the driver cancelled 3 min 25 s later [F11][F4]. The driver's post-trip statement that he waited more than 4 minutes and called twice [F13] is consistent with, and not needed beyond, the timeline record [F2][F3]. The heavy rain [F16] and the Maxwell Road speed band [F14] do not alter the no-show test, which is about the driver's presence and wait at the pickup [NS-1].

Because every NS-1 condition is met, NS-2 (which would require full refund and a possible account flag) is not engaged; the $6.61 cancellation fee stands and the trace marks no account action [F18][NS-1][NS-2][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read all three chat messages (driver's arrival notice, the rider's "give me 2 more minutes", and the driver's "Called twice, no answer. Cancelling.") plus the rider's complaint and the driver's statement; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — the driver's "Cancelling" is a factual notice, not a threat [F9][F10][F11][F13][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].
